responsibility: Supplies ELF and GNU/Linux object-format configuration for the SPU target. It defines assembler section behavior, BSS output, startfile/endfile and linker specs, sysroot-oriented library and include search adjustments, debugging format defaults, and SPU-specific LIB_SPEC selections for cache manager and cache-size support libraries, complementing spu.h by controlling how compiled SPU code is linked and laid out in ELF environments.
